exec: pm.test('TI-AUTH-01 user presente sem password', function () { pm.expect(json.user).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(json.user.password).to.be.undefined; });
pm.test('TI-USERS-01 user sem password', function () { pm.expect(json.data.id).to.exist; pm.expect(json.data.password).to.be.undefined; });
pm.test('TI-MEAS-01 sem alerta critico', function () { pm.expect(json.alert === null || json.alert.classification !== 'CRITICO').to.eql(true); });
pm.test('TI-AUDIT-01 log relevante contem campos', function () { const log = json.data.find(item => item.userId && item.action && item.timestamp); pm.expect(log).to.exist; });

item.name: TI-AUDIT-04 - Audit contem operacao de escrita

exec: pm.test('TI-AUDIT-04 contem CREATE_HERB ou CREATE_PLAN', function () { const found = json.data.some(item => ['CREATE_HERB', 'CREATE_PLAN', 'CREATE_BATCH', 'CREATE_TASK'].includes(item.action)); pm.expect(found).to.eql(true); });
